english:
Quickly throws a <solar Throwing Hammer /> that deals <pve 539 /> <pvp [90] /> damage.

Deals increased damage based on the distance traveled, up to 36% increased Throwing Hammer damage at 35+ meters. This bonus is multiplicative to everything.

Distance traveled:
• Less than 2 meters: no increase
• 2 to 4 meters: 6%
• 5 to 8 meters: 12%
• 9 to 16 meters: 18%
• 17 to 25 meters: 24%
• 26 to 34 meters: 30%
• 35 meters or more: 36%

Picking the Hammer up from the ground grants 121.5% Melee Ability Energy. Picking it up after scoring a hit grants 1 stack of <solar Cure />.

The Hammer explodes automatically after 10 seconds on the ground, dealing up to <pve 325 /> <pvp [60] /> damage. This explosion counts as Melee Damage.
